SELECT '上报' as action, r.create_time as action_time, CONCAT('市民', u.nickname, '上报发现流浪动物') as content FROM stray_report r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.id = #{reportId}
UNION ALL
SELECT CASE tl.action WHEN 'respond' THEN '响应' WHEN 'catch' THEN '捕捉' WHEN 'transport' THEN '转运' WHEN 'treat' THEN '治疗' WHEN 'recover' THEN '康复' WHEN 'adopt' THEN '领养' ELSE tl.action END, tl.create_time, tl.content FROM task_log tl WHERE tl.task_id IN (SELECT id FROM task WHERE order_id = #{orderId})
ORDER BY action_time ASC
